Good afternoon everyone, here are the results of the junior final. In first place, with a total of sixteen point four, from right here on this beach: Toby Nguyen. Toby was a rookie last season and today he is the champion. The runner-up is Marcus Hill, with fifteen point one. It was a close final and both scores were excellent. The prize giving is at four o'clock, next to the tower. And one quick note: yesterday's delay was our fault, not the ocean's, and we are sorry about that.

So that was my weekend. Friday was horrible. We were at the beach at seven and the ocean was completely flat. We were there for five hours and nothing happened. My mum was furious, my brother was bored, and I was cold. Then Saturday came. The conditions were unbelievable, the crowd was huge, and my first heat was at half past seven. I wasn't nervous, which was strange. I was third in my heat, so I am out, but honestly it was the best day of the season.
